messages:
maria: FYI I just had a sync with Jordan (Ampere) — they're ready to run our Preview EAP next month if we can lock NDA + bench plan by EOD Fri.
kevin: Nice. Do we have a one-pager for what EAP entails (scope, allowed workloads, data handling)?
sophia: I drafted a short doc earlier this week -> https://redwood.in/ampere-eap-draft (internal). It covers workloads, telemetry we need, and minimal infra reqs.
aj: For benchmarks we should define: models, seq len, batch sizes, and warmup. Also a canonical command so partner runs are comparable.
maria: Agreed. Proposal: start with rwd-3b and rwd-13b; seq=1024 and 2048; batch 1,4,8. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, throughput (tokens/sec), VRAM peak, and failure rate.
jordan_ampere: That sounds good. Ampere will also report power draw and GPU temps. We can share NV stats but not customer traces — NDA covers that.
kevin: Who publishes the harness? We should provide a Docker image + a `run_bench` wrapper to reduce env drift.
sophia: I'll build an image: `registry.redwood/infer-bench:ampere-eap-v1` with `run_bench --model rwd-13b --seq 2048 --batch 4 --out results.json`.
aj: Add a checksum step so we can validate the binary/weights used. Also assert exact tokenizer version.
maria: Legal asks: get Ampere to sign our standard partner NDA + a one-way data usage clause (telemetry for tuning only). Jordan can you confirm their legal timeline?
jordan_ampere: Legal says ~7 business days if we use their standard agreement; they're open to our one-way clause. I'll push a redline if needed.
kevin: Timeline check — if NDA signed by Mar 31, runs in first two weeks of Apr, we can analyze and ship a joint preview post by mid-April. Is that OK with PM and comms?
sophia: PM + comms green as long as we don't promise public benchmarks — it's a preview + partner blog co-authored. Need approvals for any numbers we publish.
ops-bot: calendar: Ampere EAP kickoff scheduled 2026-04-03 10:00 PT (invite created) :calendar:
maria: Great. Action items: (1) Sophia -> deliver Docker + runbook by Fri, (2) Kevin -> checklist for legal + checksum, (3) Aj -> canonical metrics spreadsheet and ingestion pipeline hooks, (4) Jordan -> NDA redline timeline. I'll follow up in #partnerships tomorrow.
kevin: I'll ping legal and add the NDA draft to the doc.
jordan_ampere: Thanks all — Ampere will prep infra access and a contact for logs (s3/bucket) once NDA is in place.
maria: Small note: no customer data in runs; only synthetic load and our curated prompts. We'll enforce via the runbook. :lock:
aj: I'll make the metrics sheet and add columns: run_id, model_hash, tokenizer_hash, seq, batch, p50, p95, tps, vram_peak, power_avg, notes.
sophia: I'll drop the image and a minimal example snippet in the doc. Example: ```bash
run_bench --model rwd-3b --seq 1024 --batch 4 --iterations 100 --out s3://ampere-eap/results.json
```
maria: Perfect. Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source for EAP coordination. If anything changes, ping here. :thumbsup:
